purpose: Non-admission source discovery of a modelled global crop-area comparator to MapSPAM 2020; original CROPGRIDS and derived FAO/CGIAR file identities, data rights and scientific dependence require independent review.

entries.name: FAO CROPGRIDS 2020 global crop and harvested area maps
entries.provider: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) / CROPGRIDS research consortium
entries.spatial_scope: Global land grid, 0.05 degree (~5.6 km at equator); maps are modelled allocation, not field or insured parcel observations
entries.temporal_scope: Crop physical and harvested area for reference year 2020; original scientific data descriptor published 2024 and FAO page updated 2025, distinct from 2026 CGIAR COG rehosting
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 173 crop identities at approximately 0.05-degree grid with physical crop area and harvested area; original research release NetCDF on Figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.22491997, FAO CGIAR 2.0 cloud COG layer offers 171 distinct per-crop file entries
entries.note: FAO and the 2024 Scientific Data paper describe 173 crops with original research NetCDF files (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.22491997); a 2026 CGIAR catalog presents a derived FAO COG representation with 171 unique crop file choices plus aliases. Do not silently equate 171 files with 173 crop concepts, or physical area with harvested area: multiple harvests can make harvested area greater. CROPGRIDS uses the older MRF dataset, gridded research products, 52-country subnational observations and FAOSTAT 2020 national totals; it is NOT an independent national-total validation for MapSPAM or FAOSTAT. Provider derivative catalog says CC BY 4.0 and a Figshare record v9 is indexed as CC BY 4.0; pin original exact file rights, version, provenance, crop-code mapping, nodata and aggregation before use. No TIV or observed insurer losses.
